title: Transition from response to recovery
cross_references: Emergency Relief and Recovery public information sources
An Agreement For Transition Of Coordination Arrangements From Response To Recovery

nodes.text: Begin planning for recovery coordination simultaneously with response

evidence.source_text: Planning for recovery coordination will commence simultaneously with response.

nodes.text: Consider key factors impacting transition timing

evidence.source_text: The decision relating to the timing of the formal transition of response to recovery coordination will be impacted by a number of key considerations, including:

nodes.text: Assess nature of hazard/threat and risk of recurrence

evidence.source_text: the nature of the hazard/threat and whether there is a risk of a recurring threat

nodes.text: Evaluate extent of impact on communities for potential prolonged transition

evidence.source_text: the extent of impact on communities, as this may determine if a prolonged transition period needs to be implemented

nodes.text: Determine extent and level of impact and needs associated with the incident

evidence.source_text: the extent of and known level of impact and needs associated with the incident

nodes.text: Consider extent of emergency relief required by affected communities

evidence.source_text: the considerations for the extent of emergency relief required by affected communities

nodes.text: Assess resources required for effective recovery arrangements

evidence.source_text: the considerations for the resources required for effective recovery arrangements.

nodes.text: Determine transition structure and handover requirements

evidence.source_text: The transition structure and handover requirements to establish formal recovery coordination arrangements will be determined by the Incident Controller, the Incident Emergency Response Coordinator and Municipal Recovery Manager, in consultation with the Regional and/or State Recovery Coordinators when appropriate.

nodes.text: Establish transition period for prolonged campaign incidents

evidence.source_text: In a prolonged campaign incident, a transition period will be established to allow sufficient time for briefing, resource planning and implementation of immediate recovery services.

nodes.text: Refer to An Agreement For Transition Of Coordination Arrangements From Response To Recovery for schedule of transition actions

evidence.source_text: A schedule of transition actions required is available in the document An Agreement For Transition Of Coordination Arrangements From Response To Recovery, which can be obtained from Regional or State Recovery Coordinators.

Consideration: extent and level of impact
